description: Run the AI-DLC `user-stories` stage (inception phase) in isolation, without advancing the main workflow. Packages `/aidlc --stage user-stories --single`: the engine emits one run-stage directive for user-stories and its gate, the conductor runs it, then the single-stage run commits a synthetic-id pair and stops. The main workflow's Current Stage is never touched.
